question: What does the lecturer say a pilgrim should do if they break a bone or become lame while in ihram?
rewritten_query: What does the lecturer say a pilgrim should do if they break a bone or become lame while in ihram?

So another narration which is of very similar sort is just the one word is added here which is marid. So whoever breaks a bone, falls sick or becomes lame has exited ihram and he has to perform Hajj the following year.

Only a few are pilgrims. What does that mean? Only few have the right intention or only few will get acceptance. So may Allah make us among those few.
